    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:12.099
    | text      = because what he's describing is essentially how you get trapped in motivated thinking.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:17.300
    | text      = He exists within the InfoWars structure, which is a deeply conspiratorial space.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:22.099
    | text      = That is to say that nothing can be explained away by coincidence unless it's absolutely necessary.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:27.699
    | text      = If you need to get Trump off the hook for something, maybe you can say it's a coincidence.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:31.059
    | text      = But other than that, things that are happening in the world are happening because the globalists
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:35.699

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:37.539

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:44.579

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:02.019

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
